title: WWC — Find and share campsites on a map
description: Browse campsites on an interactive map, see ratings, photos and tent capacity, and share your own spots with the camping community. Free to browse.

open_graph.image_alt: WWC: a map of campsites shared by campers

page.heading: Find and share campsites on a map
page.intro: WWC is a free, community-made map of campsites. Anyone can browse it; campers with an account add the spots they know, with photos, tags and the number of tents that fit.
features: Browse every campsite on an interactive map, no account needed
Search campsites by name and filter them by tags and tent capacity
See photos, ratings and comments from other campers
Sign up to post your own campsites, rate and comment on others
Report wrong or inappropriate content to the moderators
